h: Round the corner from the Cornhill
p: Upper Brook Street is right in the middle of Ipswich, a couple of minutes from the Cornhill, where the grand Victorian Town Hall and old Corn Exchange look over the main square. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre, so it's over 18s only.

If you're in town for the day, take a look at the Ancient House on the Buttermarket, a timber-framed building with remarkable decorative plasterwork on the outside. Christchurch Park is a short walk north and has Christchurch Mansion, a Tudor house with a fine art collection that includes works by Constable and Gainsborough. Head south instead and the Waterfront has a marina, restaurants and bars along the old dock, a cracking spot for an evening drink. On matchdays, Portman Road brings the crowds into town.
